name: TollPlugin
description: SAE J3217 Electronic Toll Collection plugin for V2X Hub. Broadcasts TollAdvertisementMessage (TAM), receives and validates TollUsageMessage (TUM), creates transactions, and sends TollUsageAckMessage (TumAck). Phase 2: JSON encoding. Phase 3: ASN.1 + IEEE 1609.2.

messageTypes.name: TollAdvertisementMessage
messageTypes.description: Toll zone advertisement broadcast to OBEs at TamBroadcastIntervalMs

messageTypes.name: TollUsageMessage
messageTypes.description: Toll usage report from OBE after gantry crossing. Validated before transaction.

messageTypes.name: TollUsageAckMessage
messageTypes.description: Acknowledgment of TUM processing (accepted or rejected with reason code).
